class.name: IfcBeam
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO 6707-1:1989 : Structural member designed to carry loads between or beyond points of support, usually narrow in relation to its length and horizontal or nearly so. An IfcBeam is a horizontal, or nearly horizontal, structural member that is capable of withstanding load primarily by resisting bending.
